info.title: ALL 5.75 Customer API
info.description: The customer app API. All money is an integer number of halalas (575 = 5.75 SAR), VAT included. Send Authorization: Bearer <token> after signing in with a one-time code.

post.summary: Send a one-time code. The answer is the same whether or not the number already has an account
Check the code and sign in. A new account must also send the current Terms and Privacy versions

post.summary:
Creates the unpaid order and the payment attempt. The order is only confirmed later, by the provider's callback.
Repeating the request with the same Idempotency-Key returns the same order instead of creating another
